body.x: Lancey presented the first electric smart heater with a built-in battery at 'CES 2018 Unveiled' in 7th of January in Las Vegas, United States.

Lancey's smart heater is at the forefront of the next generation of electric heaters, equipped with a battery and automatic sensing. It unifies renewable energy so that everyone can participate and actualise in energy conversion.

The natural lithographs of the heater are combined with an infrared radiation panel to provide immediate warmth while ensuring stable temperatures and optimum comfort. It also has a comfortable way to operate and remote control. If the window is open automatically, the sensor is operating automatically so that heater stops working in order to save energy. Also, it is user-friendly because of the automatic setting system in accordance with weather data and the habits of users.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
